gates.criterion: An inhabited scene of active investigation is readable from evidence documentation, the damaged closure and stopped delivery; warehouse handling alone fails.
gates.pass_requires: Every described component and connection visible together. Partial or unobservable evidence fails the full gate.
gates.evidence: The primary subject holds a camera and a scale against the crate closure while a separate clerk pauses the trolley; evidence marker and controlled loading bay make active investigative documentation readable.

gates.criterion: The primary investigator retains the supplied portrait visible face shape, dark eyes and dark bob/fringe at a usable review scale; this is appearance correspondence, not identity.
gates.pass_requires: Every described component and connection visible together. Partial or unobservable evidence fails the full gate.
gates.evidence: The investigator retains the supplied rounded cheek/face impression, dark eyes, chin-length dark bob and wispy fringe in a clear three-quarter face view. This supports appearance guidance, not real identity.

gates.criterion: The investigator owns the compact camera in the right hand and aims it toward the same broken seal being inspected.

gates.evidence: Her upper right hand visibly owns the compact camera; her arm chain is continuous and the camera points toward the crate-closure work area below it, shared with the scale.

gates.criterion: The investigator left hand places a measuring scale flat on the crate directly below the seal break without hiding the gap.

gates.criterion: Both severed red security-seal ends and their gap are visible together at the crate hasp; a continuous loop or a merely loose strip fails.

gates.criterion: A distinct receiving clerk has both hands on the trolley handle and waits while the investigator documents the crate.

gates.evidence: A separate receiving clerk behind the crate has both gloved hands around the same metal trolley handle and looks toward the work area.

gates.evidence: A trolley caster and platform corner are visible, but the crate base/platform relation is largely cropped and both actors feet are outside the saved frame. The testcase requires these support endpoints to be assessable together; no bodily defect is diagnosed.
